_note: HTTP tools for the intake agent. Replace {{BASE_URL}} with the cloudflared URL and set header X-Tool-Secret to TOOL_SECRET from .env. All tools are POST with a JSON body and return JSON with a speakable `say` and a `next_action` hint. get_status long-polls up to 25 s (Sarvam tool timeout is 30 s).

tools.name: find_leads
tools.description: Plan a blood search. Finds blood banks and eligible donors near the hospital. Calls NOBODY. Returns request_id and a summary to read to the user, then you must ask for permission before start_calls.

blood_group.description: Patient blood group, e.g. B+, O-, AB+

location.description: Hospital name where the patient is

deadline_hours.description: Hours until the blood is needed

component.description: packed red cells | whole blood | platelets. Omit if not stated.

tools.name: start_calls
tools.description: Start phoning the banks and donors for a request. Only call after the user explicitly said yes. Set confirmed=true only then; the server refuses otherwise.

confirmed.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to start calls

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Wait (up to 25 s) for new call results and return a short update in `say`. Keep calling until done=true. If needs_approval=true, ask the user and wait.

tools.name: approve_wave2
tools.description: Widen the search to the larger radius. Only after the user said yes to widening.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Stop a request: no further calls are made. Use when the user says stop/cancel or declines widening.
